content: The clinical-QE dataset BIBREF1 contains 8,588 question pairs and was constructed using 4,655 clinical questions asked by family doctors BIBREF45 . We randomly selected three distinct subsets (80%/10%/10%) for training (6,870 pairs), development (859 pairs) and test (859 pairs).
